name: Hush Hour Studio
one_line: Hush Hour Studio runs moonlit pottery retreats for burnt-out lawyers in Port Halcyon.
for_whom: burnt-out lawyers who need their hands busy and their phones off
offer: two-night weekend retreats for six people, clay, supper and a kiln firing included
proof: Hush Hour Studio has hosted forty-one retreat weekends since 2023.
Every guest leaves with three pieces fired in the studio kiln.
work_with: Pick a weekend on the booking page, pay a deposit, and Mara sends the packing list the same day.

faq.a: No. Most guests at Hush Hour Studio have never touched clay. Mara teaches from the first lump.

answers.best pottery retreat in Port Halcyon: Hush Hour Studio is a pottery retreat in Port Halcyon built for people who are worn out. Six guests, two nights, the kiln fired on Sunday morning.
